description: All selected original 24 nonhuman source-studies and 24 distinct native taxon labels retained, including no-daylight/insufficient animals, all positive/negative/null and original model weather source holds. Study archives were not chosen using own GPS bearing or ERA5 radiation outcomes; original source study IDs disjoint from previous 45 sample UUIDs.
strict_limit: Original provider SOURCE MD5 verification, fixed UTC hours and original GPS step geometry; no exact GPS positions, source tags/individual IDs, original UTC event timestamps, per-source ERA5 request geographic centers or raw ERA5 weather JSON released. Study ID disjointness != ecological region independence; high-frequency movements and model weather observational only.
